citationText: 7. U.S. Pat. 1085868, filed by A. König, 1913 . A telecentric lens is one in which the middle rays of emerging light beams proceeding towards different parts of the final image are approximately parallel to the optical axis. The exit pupil is thus very distant, a fact which gives the name to this type of system.
